name: @gcu/theme
description: One theme vocabulary for GCU figures: the keys (background, foreground, muted, grid, frame, panel, accent, cycle, fonts, …), dark/light/paper themes from the Switchboard palette, and themeFromCSS to take a host page's design tokens. Shared by @gcu/condenser's view and @gcu/plot, so one theme dresses a chart and the 3D view beside it. Zero dependencies.
author: Arthur Endlein Correia
